title: Steel Chest
description: Upper body in two classic blocks: push with varied push-ups and reinforced back pull

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Dive movement: pike down then sweep up in an arc

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.instructions: One arm extended to the side, lower toward the other hand

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Inverse table rows
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms along the body, arc on the floor

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift torso off the floor, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
